title: Claim closure: open tasks block closure, bulk closure
walkthroughSteps: Open tasks: a claim with open tasks cannot close. The Close claim window lists every open task with its type and domain, next to the other blockers (AC-01). Done, cancelled or deferred tasks do not block (AC-02). Automatic closure after the final payment uses the same rule and says so in a toast.
Bulk closure: select sections on Section overview (or claims on Claims list), one Close action, one reason and one checklist tick, then a result per item (AC-03 to AC-07).
Not built: story AC05 (Figma file, German text length, PO and Ranger review) is outside the prototype.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC01 · Blocked claim closure lists every open task with its type and domain, together with the other blockers
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001, with the Close claim window already open.

**You see:** The blockers step. The open tasks card is expanded and lists both tasks one by one, each with **Type** and **Domain** (Review task from Recovery, Finance task from Reserves and payments), status, assignee and due date. The open section is listed as a second blocker in the same list.

**Try:** Press **Go to Task manager** to see the tasks there.

Decision: open tasks are a normal blocker card in the existing closure window (extended, not a new screen), expanded by default so no task hides behind a count. Wording: "2 open tasks (Recovery, Reserves and payments) must be completed, cancelled or deferred". No override (PO).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Completed, cancelled or deferred tasks no longer block closure
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001, Close claim window open.

**You see:** The pre-closure checklist straight away, with a new first row **No open tasks** ticked. The two extra tasks exist but one is **Cancelled** and one **Deferred**, so they do not count as open (epic BMPCC-21933 FR1).

**Try:** Continue through reason and confirmation: the claim closes.

expectedUI.description: Checklist shows No open tasks as passed; closure can go ahead.

howToTest.trigger: Applied automatically: the Close claim window opens on the checklist.
howToTest.expectedResult: Checklist shows No open tasks as passed; closure can go ahead.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC02 · Select several or all sections and close them in one action
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Sections of CLM-2024-001, all four sections open and nothing blocking them.

**You see:** A checkbox on every section row and a **select all** checkbox in the header.

**Try:** Tick select all. A grey bar says **4 sections selected** with **Close 4 sections**. Press it: the Close 4 sections window checks every section and says **All 4 sections can be closed. Nothing is blocking them.**

Decision: the screens with bulk closure are Section overview (sections) and Claims list (claims). One section selected uses the existing single Close section window; two or more use the bulk window. Same selection bar also offers Reopen for closed sections (BMPCC-22328).

setup.description: All four sections open, no blockers

expectedUI.description: Selection bar with one close action; the window lists all four as Ready to close.

howToTest.trigger: Tick the header checkbox, then press Close 4 sections.
howToTest.expectedResult: Selection bar with one close action; the window lists all four as Ready to close.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC03 · Reason and checklist confirmation once for the batch, result per item with partial success
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Sections of CLM-2024-001. Four open sections; **Contents & Fixtures Damage** still has an open reserve.

**You see:** After select all and **Close 4 sections**: a warning **3 of 4 can be closed. 1 section stays open**, and the blocked one shows why (Pending reserves must be released).

**Try:** **Continue with 3 sections**. The confirm step names the 3 that will close and the 1 that stays open, asks for **one closure reason** and **one tick** for the pre-closure checklist. **Close 3 sections**: a short spinner, then the result per item: 3 **Closed**, 1 **Not closed** with its reason.

Decision: partial success, the blocked section is never closed and there is no override (PO). Items are checked again at close time.

setup.description: Four open sections, one with an open reserve

expectedUI.description: 3 closed, 1 not closed, with the reason per item.

howToTest.trigger: Select all, Close 4 sections, Continue, pick a reason, tick the confirmation, Close 3 sections.
howToTest.expectedResult: 3 closed, 1 not closed, with the reason per item.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC03 · Bulk claim closure: a claim with open tasks stays open and its tasks are listed
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claims list.

**You see:** The claims table with a checkbox per claim.

**Try:** Tick **CLM-2024-001** and **CLM-2024-002**, press **Close 2 claims**. CLM-2024-001 is **Ready to close**; CLM-2024-002 **Stays open** and lists each open task with type and domain (Legal task from Litigation, Approval task from Claims) next to its other blockers. Continue, pick a reason, tick the checklist, close: 1 closed, 1 not closed.

Decision: bulk claim closure uses the default 10 year retention for every claim; a custom date needs the single closure on Claim overview.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC04 · Error state: a close that fails can be tried again
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Sections of CLM-2024-001, all four open, no blockers. Closing **Section 004: Payment Demo** is set to fail once (prototype switch).

**You see:** After closing all 4: **3 sections closed, 1 not closed**, Section 004 shows **Could not close: Something went wrong while closing. Nothing was changed, try again.**

**Try:** **Try again for 1 section**: it closes, the result turns to 4 sections closed. Loading state: the spinner while checking and while closing.

setup.description: Four open sections, one close fails once

preconditions.text: Could not close + Try again for 1 section

expectedUI.description: Failed item can be retried; nothing else changes.
visualCues: Could not close + Try again for 1 section

howToTest.trigger: Select all, Close 4 sections, Continue, reason, tick, Close 4 sections, then Try again.
howToTest.expectedResult: Failed item can be retried; nothing else changes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC04 · Nothing can close: only Cancel, no override
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Sections of CLM-2024-001. Two open sections, both with something open (reserves, payments).

**You see:** After select all and **Close 2 sections**: **None of the selected sections can be closed yet**, each with its reasons. There is no Continue button, only Cancel.

expectedUI.description: Nothing-can-close state; no way to force it.
visualCues: None of the selected sections can be closed yet

howToTest.expectedResult: Nothing-can-close state; no way to force it.
